biotools.summary: SpaHDmap is an interpretable multimodal deep-learning framework that integrates spatial transcriptomics gene expression with high-resolution histology images (e.g., H&E/IHC) to produce high-resolution spatial metagenes by embedding non-negative matrix factorization in a neural network.
